raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00), so 349 rows are exact duplicates. That accounts for the 698 rows in the batch against about 350 normally, and for 327 duplicated POSTED txn_ids. Silver has no dedup, so every gold table double-counts those rows. The fix is to keep one row per txn_id in silver_transactions.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) = 1"}}
